about: Jonah is the story of a prophet who ran away from God and learned how much God cares for everyone.

pages.title: Jonah Runs Away
pages.scene: Jonah's ship in a big storm
pages.text: God told Jonah, "Go to Nineveh. Tell them to stop doing wrong." But Jonah didn't want to. He got on a ship going the other way. God sent a big storm. Jonah said, "It's my fault. Throw me into the sea."

pages.title: Inside the Big Fish
pages.scene: Jonah praying inside the big fish
pages.text: God sent a big fish to swallow Jonah! For three days Jonah was inside the fish. He prayed and said sorry. Then God told the fish to spit Jonah out onto dry land. God gave Jonah a second chance.

pages.title: God Cares for Nineveh
pages.scene: The king of Nineveh praying in sackcloth
pages.text: This time Jonah went to Nineveh. The people listened and said sorry to God, from the king to the children. God forgave them. Jonah was grumpy, but God said, "Shouldn't I care about all these people?"
pages.lesson: God loves everyone, even people we don't like.
